verdict.rationale: RustDesk is a remote-desktop product, not an agent, so shipping an official MCP server is a plausible capability and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence mentions an MCP server or endpoint. The Server Pro management API and the llms.txt file are adjacent building blocks, not an MCP server, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
